evidence.title: US Regular All Formulations Gas Price
evidence.summary: The snapshotted target change was 5.209 percent; it resolved to 'above recent range'.

evidence.title: Fourth of July gas prices take an almost unprecedented plunge
evidence.summary: This source provides a snapshot of gasoline prices at the end of June 2023, noting a significant year-over-year drop, which sets the stage for the July price changes. It mentions the average gas price for the week ending June 26 was $3.57 a gallon and the national average for regular gasoline dipped to $3.55 a gallon on Thursday (June 29).

evidence.title: FOTW #1297, July 3, 2023: For the Past Six Months, Average Nationwide Monthly Gasoline Prices Have Been Below $4 per Gallon | Department of Energy
evidence.summary: This source provides historical context, stating that average nationwide monthly gasoline prices have been below $4 per gallon since November 2022 and were well below the peak of $5.09/gallon in June 2022. It also notes that the highest monthly average was $5.51 in July 2008 (inflation-adjusted). This establishes a baseline for recent price trends leading into July 2023.

evidence.title: Forecast retail gasoline prices for summer 2023 will be lower than last summer - U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)
evidence.summary: This April 2023 forecast from the EIA predicted that U.S. retail gasoline prices for summer 2023 would average about $3.50 per gallon, significantly lower than the previous summer. It also stated that prices were estimated to increase slightly from current levels later in the summer due to seasonal factors and rising crude oil prices. This provides an early indication of expected upward pressure on prices during the summer months, including July.

evidence.title: Year-over-year Declines in Motor Gasoline Prices Dampen Inflation Despite Motor Gasoline Prices Rising 10% from December 2022 to May 2023
evidence.domain: united states. department of transportation. bureau of transportation statistics
evidence.summary: This report highlights that while retail gasoline prices declined 27% from their June 2022 peak by May 2023, they had also risen 10% from December 2022 to May 2023. This indicates an upward trend in the months leading up to July 2023, suggesting potential for continued increases.

evidence.title: Lower U.S. gasoline prices may be their own undoing - UPI.com
evidence.summary: This article, published early in July, references the Energy Department's June forecast of an annual retail average of $3.39 per gallon. This provides a benchmark for expected prices, and any deviation from this forecast during July would indicate a change.

evidence.title: EIA's July gasoline price forecast among the highest so far this year - UPI.com
evidence.summary: This source reports on the EIA's July forecast, which estimated the retail price would average $3.40 for a gallon of regular unleaded gasoline for the year. Crucially, it notes that this forecast was among the highest so far in 2023, and that retail-level prices had yet to respond to a spike in crude oil prices resulting from Saudi Arabia's decision to curtail oil production. This directly points to an upward pressure on prices for July.

evidence.title: Higher Cost of Oil Nudges Gas Prices Higher – AAA Newsroom
evidence.summary: This AAA article explicitly states that the higher cost of oil is nudging gas prices higher, confirming the impact of crude oil prices on retail gasoline prices during July.

evidence.title: Retail gasoline prices could rise in response to oil production cuts, AAA warns - UPI.com
evidence.summary: This article directly links potential retail gasoline price increases to oil production cuts by Saudi Arabia and Russia. This is a strong mechanism for upward price movement in July.

evidence.title: U.S. Gasoline & Oil Prices Move Up - Haver Analytics
evidence.summary: This source provides a mid-to-late July update, stating that retail gasoline prices improved two cents last week to an average $3.66 per gallon. This confirms an upward movement in prices during July.

evidence.title: Retail gasoline prices spike on refinery issues, Saudi production restraint - UPI.com
evidence.summary: Published at the very end of July, this article confirms a spike in retail gasoline prices, attributing it to refinery issues and Saudi production restraint. It notes the national average retail price at $3.76 per gallon for Monday (July 31), which is 22 cents per gallon higher than the previous month. This directly supports a significant increase in July.
